work.company: Institute of Medical Philosophy and Future AI (IMPFAI)
work.title: Psoriasis Literature Analysis Project
work.description:
This research project developed an advanced neural topic model to analyze comprehensive psoriasis literature data. Using deep learning natural language processing technology, we successfully identified research hotspots and trends in psoriasis studies. The project resulted in interactive web-based visualization tools that enable clinicians and patients to efficiently explore and compare research topics across different time periods.

Published in the Journal of Investigative Dermatology (2025), this work demonstrates the significant impact of AI-driven literature analysis on medical research and patient health education.
